title: Lucy Maud Montgomery's birth chart
metaDescription: Lucy Maud Montgomery's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.3° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled fall in fixed signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. Fixed signs hold the middle of their seasons, and a fixed-heavy chart is read as one that consolidates and does not easily let go.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 8.3° Sagittarius. That falls in the first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the classical scheme — a fire sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 18.1° Scorpio; Venus stands at 21.8° Sagittarius; Mars stands at 16.9° Libra. The tradition reads a mind that absorbs before it argues from Mercury, taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Saturn hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 1.3° wide. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Mars sextile Uranus at 1.7°, and Venus sextile Jupiter at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Pluto while both square Uranus. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, two sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Mars in Libra at 16.9° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aquarius at 9.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 4 fire, 3 air, 2 earth, 1 water by element and 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal by modality. Venus, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Virgo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.4° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 7.3°.
